name: feature.insights-suite.nodes
description: Insights & Drafting Agent Suite node pack — pure compute building blocks the suite's meta-workflows use. variance-compute (Actual-vs-Plan for store sales/margin/labor/shrink, flags off-plan metrics, and a reviewer summary), talent-score (9-box performance×potential readiness), recognition-brief (the fenced, fail-closed brief the recognition draft step drafts from) and draft-check (refuses an empty draft before the approval gate). No host surface, no external egress — deterministic, replay-safe.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Variance: Actual vs Plan
nodes.description: Computes Actual-vs-Plan deltas + percentages for a business unit's sales/margin/labor/shrink and flags metrics beyond a threshold. Accepts explicit actuals/plan metric maps OR a tabular rows set carrying metric/actual/plan columns. FAILS CLOSED with insufficient_data when zero metrics could be evaluated, and again when every metric read has a plan of 0 — an empty or uncomparable variance set is never reported as 'on_plan'. A NULL/blank/boolean cell is an absence, never a zero (ADR 0599 §3 + §Correction 1). Emits a deterministic `summary` string (each metric's actual/plan/delta/%, the flagged, missing and uncomparable metrics, and the verdict) for an approval gate to show its reviewer (ADR 1102 D9). Pure compute.

nodes.label: Talent: 9-box readiness
nodes.description: Maps a person's performance (1-3) × potential (1-3) to a 9-box cell + a readiness category. Ratings come from explicit inputs (clamped into 1-3) or a rows review set matched on subjectId (NOT clamped — the source scale is unknowable to the node). FAILS CLOSED with insufficient_data when either rating is absent, ambiguous_data when the review rows disagree across cycles, and unknown_scale when a row rating falls outside 1-3 — a named person is never placed in a 9-box cell from missing, arbitrary or mis-scaled data (ADR 0599 §3 + §Correction 1/4). Pure compute.

nodes.label: Recognition: draft brief
nodes.description: Builds the one user turn a recognition draft step drafts from: the person, the milestone (supplied, or STATED on their Workday row as `milestone` or a numeric `serviceYears` — never derived from a date and a clock) and up to 5 voice exemplars from the knowledge base, all inside one BEGIN/END UNTRUSTED CONTENT fence with both fence syntaxes defanged. FAILS CLOSED with subject_required, insufficient_data (no milestone, or no exemplars) and ambiguous_data (the rows state two milestones). Sets the run's ADR 1009 untrusted-context bit, so a capability-token link cannot decide the approval that follows. Deterministic; no host surface, no egress (ADR 1102 D2).

nodes.label: Draft: refuse empty
nodes.description: Passes a drafted text through unchanged, and FAILS CLOSED with insufficient_data when it is blank, so an approval gate never shows an empty draft and a mailbox never receives one (ADR 1102 D3). Pure compute.
